title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 47 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.5).

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 25, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-93952 as actively exploited
